correctness.rationale: Every exactly-two-b word has normal form b a^k b a^j on Q. After the first b and rotation, the second b lowers rank exactly when the missing state is outside the two-element kernel class. On those states b is a bijection onto Q\{e,d}, so the oriented missing-state difference ranges over every nonzero residue except rho=d-e. A target pair fails in both orientations exactly when its difference equals its negative and rho, i.e. n is even and rho=n/2 with antipodal holes. The explicit witness has length 2+k+j<=2n. The packaged verifier exhaustively checks all rank-(n-1) maps through n=7 and deterministic random cases through n=13.

evidence: Hoffmann 2020 obtains complete reachability for arbitrary rank-(n-1) maps adjoined to primitive groups; an n-cycle alone is primitive only for prime n.
Zhu 2024 gives n(n-k)+n-1 for standardized completely reachable automata and exhibits general binary counterexamples to Don.
Ferens-Szykuła 2026 give 2n(n-|S|)-n H_{n-|S|} for completely reachable automata, equal to 5n/2 at codimension two.

None of these inspected statements implies the composite-n, arbitrary rank-(n-1), local codimension-two 2n result without complete reachability. Conversely, the present result is not broader for smaller target sizes.

equivalent_formulations.reasoning: The new statement is not merely a renaming of Don's coprime-displacement theorem: it covers non-coprime displacement at codimension two and does not assume complete reachability. originality.rationale: The claim extends the codimension-two 2n conclusion beyond Don's coprime-displacement condition and beyond standardized completely reachable automata, while isolating an exact antipodal obstruction to using two defect-one letters. Direct full-text comparisons and published-finding corpus searches found special cases and broader results under stronger hypotheses, but no statement implying the arbitrary-map classification.
residual_risks: An older circular-automata or finite-transformation-semigroup source might contain an equivalent two-defect statement under different terminology. Searches did not locate one.
The theorem does not address overall reachability of antipodal exceptional targets with three or more occurrences of the defect-one letter.

value.rationale: Codimension two is the first nontrivial reaching layer and is where the known binary counterexamples to Don occur. The theorem gives a complete local classification for the broad cycle-plus-rank-(n-1) model, explains exactly when two defect-one steps suffice, removes coprimality in all nonexceptional cases, and identifies a sharp parity obstruction. The 2n coefficient is also sharp over the class via the known Černý family.
